local Junkie = loadstring(game:HttpGet("https://jnkie.com/sdk/library.lua"))()
Junkie.service = "Wisl"
Junkie.identifier = "2433"
Junkie.provider = "Wisl"

getgenv().SCRIPT_KEY = nil
getgenv().UI_CLOSED = false

local function saveKey(k)
    if writefile and type(k) == "string" and #k > 0 then
        pcall(writefile, "WislKey.txt", k)
    end
end

local function loadSavedKey()
    if not readfile then return nil end
    local ok, content = pcall(readfile, "WislKey.txt")
    if ok and type(content) == "string" and #content > 0 then
        return content
    end
    return nil
end

local function validateKey(k)
    if type(k) ~= "string" or #k == 0 then return false end
    local r = Junkie.check_key(k)
    if r and (r.valid or r.success) then
        getgenv().SCRIPT_KEY = k
        getgenv().UI_CLOSED = true
        return true
    end
    return false
end

local function tryKeyless()
    getgenv().SCRIPT_KEY = "KEYLESS"
    getgenv().UI_CLOSED = true
    return true
end

local function shakeEffect(f)
    local op = f.Position
    local st = true
    task.spawn(function()
        while st do
            f.Position = UDim2.new(op.X.Scale, op.X.Offset + math.random(-3, 3), op.Y.Scale, op.Y.Offset + math.random(-3, 3))
            task.wait(0.02)
        end
        f.Position = op
    end)
    return function()
        st = false
    end
end

local function showKeyDialog()
    local uiParent = (gethui and gethui()) or game:GetService("CoreGui")
    local old = uiParent:FindFirstChild("JunkieKeyGui")
    if old then old:Destroy() end

    local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
    sg.Name = "JunkieKeyGui"
    sg.ResetOnSpawn = false
    sg.Parent = uiParent

    local m = Instance.new("Frame", sg)
    m.Name = "Main"
    m.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 45, 55)
    m.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
    m.BorderSizePixel = 2
    m.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -200, 0.5, -100)
    m.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 200)

    local t = Instance.new("TextLabel", m)
    t.Name = "Title"
    t.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 45)
    t.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 30)
    t.BorderSizePixel = 2
    t.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40)
    t.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    t.Text = "Wisl Universal - Key System"
    t.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    t.TextSize = 15

    local ki = Instance.new("TextBox", m)
    ki.Name = "KeyInput"
    ki.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(55, 55, 65)
    ki.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 35)
    ki.BorderSizePixel = 2
    ki.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 55)
    ki.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 35)
    ki.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    ki.PlaceholderText = "Enter your key here..."
    ki.PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(140, 140, 150)
    ki.Text = ""
    ki.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    ki.TextSize = 13
    ki.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left

    local sb = Instance.new("TextButton", m)
    sb.Name = "SubmitBtn"
    sb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(65, 165, 85)
    sb.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 125, 65)
    sb.BorderSizePixel = 2
    sb.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 105)
    sb.Size = UDim2.new(0.45, -25, 0, 35)
    sb.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    sb.Text = "Submit"
    sb.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    sb.TextSize = 13

    local gl = Instance.new("TextButton", m)
    gl.Name = "GetLinkBtn"
    gl.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(65, 125, 195)
    gl.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 95, 165)
    gl.BorderSizePixel = 2
    gl.Position = UDim2.new(0.55, 5, 0, 105)
    gl.Size = UDim2.new(0.45, -25, 0, 35)
    gl.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    gl.Text = "Get Key"
    gl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    gl.TextSize = 13

    local dc = Instance.new("TextButton", m)
    dc.Name = "DiscordBtn"
    dc.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(65, 85, 175)
    dc.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 65, 145)
    dc.BorderSizePixel = 2
    dc.Position = UDim2.new(0, 20, 0, 150)
    dc.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 35)
    dc.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    dc.Text = "Please Join Discord"
    dc.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    dc.TextSize = 12

    local sl = Instance.new("TextLabel", sg)
    sl.Name = "StatusLabel"
    sl.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(25, 25, 45)
    sl.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 80, 120)
    sl.BorderSizePixel = 2
    sl.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -175, 0, -40)
    sl.Size = UDim2.new(0, 350, 0, 35)
    sl.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    sl.Text = "Join Discord & DM for FREE key (3 days)! :)"
    sl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 220, 255)
    sl.TextSize = 15
    sl.TextTransparency = 0

    local nf = Instance.new("TextLabel", m)
    nf.Name = "Notification"
    nf.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(80, 195, 115)
    nf.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 155, 85)
    nf.BorderSizePixel = 2
    nf.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -75, 0, -40)
    nf.Size = UDim2.new(0, 150, 0, 30)
    nf.Font = Enum.Font.Code
    nf.Text = "Key Valid!"
    nf.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    nf.TextSize = 13
    nf.Visible = false

    local ss = nil

    sb.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        local k = ki.Text
        if not k or #k == 0 then
            sl.Text = "Please enter a key"
            sl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
            return
        end

        sl.Text = "Validating..."
        sl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 100)
        if ss then ss() end
        ss = shakeEffect(m)

        local r = Junkie.check_key(k)

        if r and (r.valid or r.success) then
            if ss then ss() end
            saveKey(k)
            nf.Visible = true
            sl.Text = "Key Validated!"
            sl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 120)
            task.delay(1, function()
                getgenv().SCRIPT_KEY = k
                getgenv().UI_CLOSED = true
                sg:Destroy()
            end)
        else
            if ss then ss() end
            ss = shakeEffect(m)
            local err = tostring(r and (r.error or r.message) or "Unknown error")
            
            if err == "KEY_INVALID" then
                sl.Text = "Error: Key not found in system"
            elseif err == "KEY_EXPIRED" then
                sl.Text = "Error: Key expired - get a new one"
            elseif err == "HWID_BANNED" then
                sl.Text = "Error: Hardware banned"
                task.delay(2, function()
                    game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer:Kick("Hardware banned")
                end)
            elseif err == "KEY_INVALIDATED" then
                sl.Text = "Error: Key was manually disabled"
            elseif err == "ALREADY_USED" then
                sl.Text = "Error: One-time key already used"
            elseif err == "HWID_MISMATCH" then
                sl.Text = "Error: HWID limit reached"
            elseif err == "SERVICE_NOT_FOUND" then
                sl.Text = "Error: Service doesn't exist"
            elseif err == "SERVICE_MISMATCH" then
                sl.Text = "Error: Key for different service"
            elseif err == "PREMIUM_REQUIRED" then
                sl.Text = "Error: Premium key needed"
            elseif err == "ERROR" then
                sl.Text = "Network error - please try again"
            elseif err:match("^http %d+") then
                sl.Text = "Server Error: " .. err
            else
                sl.Text = "Error: " .. err
            end

            sl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)

            task.delay(0.5, function()
                if ss then ss() end
            end)
        end
    end)

    gl.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        sl.Text = "Getting link..."
        sl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 100)

        local l, e = Junkie.get_key_link()

        if l then
            if setclipboard then setclipboard(l) end
            sl.Text = "Link copied!"
            sl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 200, 120)
        else
            local err = tostring(e or "Unknown")
            if err == "RATE_LIMITTED" or err == "RATE_LIMITED" then
                sl.Text = "Rate limited, wait 5 minutes"
            else
                sl.Text = "Error: " .. err
            end
            sl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 100)
        end
    end)

    dc.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        if setclipboard then setclipboard("https://discord.gg/f5XD2A6jx") end
        sl.Text = "Link copied! Paste to join Discord"
        sl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 150, 255)
    end)

    return sg
end

local function main()
    if tryKeyless() then return end

    local savedKey = loadSavedKey()
    if savedKey and validateKey(savedKey) then return end

    showKeyDialog()
    repeat task.wait(0.1) until getgenv().SCRIPT_KEY or getgenv().UI_CLOSED
end

main()
